name: Restriction
look: Restriction barrier, a seal of layered runes from cultivation fantasy. Three stacked horizontal rings of glowing violet-white rune characters circle the character at knee, waist and head height, turning in alternating directions, joined by faint vertical light.
subject: shield

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: the rings draw themselves one by one from the ground up, each rune lighting as it is written

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the three rings turn against each other and their runes pulse in sequence; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes from the right; the runes of the struck ring flare bright white along its length and the ring jolts, a burst of rune sparks at the impact point

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the rings unravel layer by layer from the top, their runes peeling away and fading
